title: Claude Code Extension Could Let AI Agents Access Files Outside Trusted Workspaces Through Symlinks
content_md: Anthropic’s Claude Code extension for Visual Studio Code reportedly shows misleading file paths in its permission prompts. A researcher says this can lead users to approve file access outside their trusted workspace. Anthropic closed the report as informative and did not treat it as a vulnerability. The researcher disagrees and says the issue is unpatched […] The post Claude Code Extension Could Let AI Agents Access Files Outside Trusted Workspaces Through Symlinks appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform .
